states.name: Discovering ATHA for the first time

organizations.name: OneMundi
organizations.description: Initiator and owner. Enterprise transformation, the AI-native methodology, the commercial model, the independence of the verdict, and the ecosystem that continues between editions.

organizations.name: Warwick Business School
organizations.description: Partner and co-host. Academic environment, knowledge, participants, research, network and institutional standards.

organizations.name: Hadora
organizations.description: Rhythm, stewardship, nourishment, psychological safety and integration — the human operating system beneath the work. Shaped as a HADORA experience; felt, never prominently branded.

lenses.name: Feasibility
lenses.core_question: Can it realistically be built now?

lenses.name: Scalability
lenses.core_question: Can it grow beyond one use case?

lenses.name: Responsibility
lenses.core_question: Is it safe and fair to deploy?

verdict_states.name: Proceed
verdict_states.description: Conditions for success and an implementation pathway follow.

verdict_states.name: Redirect
verdict_states.description: The opportunity is real, the framing was wrong.

verdict_states.name: Pause
verdict_states.description: The organisation is not yet able to answer this well.

verdict_states.name: Reject
verdict_states.description: A well-supported decision not to build is a legitimate result.

arc_stages.name: Arrive & Settle
arc_stages.description: People are met rather than processed; the room is made, not booked.

arc_stages.name: Open & Sense
arc_stages.description: The question is opened before it is attacked, presented as it actually sits.

arc_stages.name: Connect
arc_stages.description: Teams form across disciplines, around the question.

arc_stages.name: Create
arc_stages.description: The longest stage: AI-native investigation, AI used fully, never accepted blindly.

arc_stages.name: Discern
arc_stages.description: Evidence, consequences, uncertainty, trade-offs — given more room than any stage except the work itself.

arc_stages.name: Celebrate
arc_stages.description: Recognition is shared rather than ranked; different forms of excellence, no overall winner.

arc_stages.name: Integrate & Return
arc_stages.description: Leave with something integrated; the relationships carry into the next edition.

recommendation_categories.name: Proceed
recommendation_categories.description: Evidence supports moving directly into a defined implementation or advanced pilot phase.

recommendation_categories.name: Conditional pilot
recommendation_categories.description: Promising, but specified assumptions must be tested before greater investment.

recommendation_categories.name: Reframe or investigate further
recommendation_categories.description: The problem may be valuable, but approach, data, scope or operating model requires substantial revision.

recommendation_categories.name: Do not proceed
recommendation_categories.description: Not sufficiently desirable, feasible, viable, scalable or responsible under current conditions.

value_forms.name: Experience
value_forms.description: The partner experiences a different way an organization can work, collaborate, rest, use AI, and produce ambitious outcomes.

value_forms.name: Perspective
value_forms.description: A wider understanding of AI — contextual intelligence, readiness, consequences, responsibility, desirability.

value_forms.name: Decision
value_forms.description: Concrete insight into whether and how to pursue the challenge: value, assumptions, risks, scalability, recommended direction.

value_forms.name: Belonging
value_forms.description: Entry into a community connecting education, research, industry, students, experience design, OneMundi and Hadora.

value_forms.name: Continuity
value_forms.description: The relationship continues: platform access, future experiences, ecosystem relationships, implementation pathways.

hadora_principles.name: Design the conditions, not the person
hadora_principles.description: ATHA creates conditions in which creativity, collaboration and responsibility emerge naturally.

hadora_principles.name: Stewardship
hadora_principles.description: Hold the container. Release the content. Stewards protect purpose, safety, rhythm and quality; participants keep freedom.

hadora_principles.name: Temporary culture, not event
hadora_principles.description: Events are consumed. Cultures are participated in. Participants become contributors and culture-makers.

hadora_principles.name: Life, Love & Laughs
hadora_principles.description: The human heartbeat beneath HADORA — experienced within ATHA without being presented as an explicit framework.

hadora_principles.name: Ambition without depletion
hadora_principles.description: ATHA rejects the assumption that ambition requires exhaustion, fear or unhealthy competition.

hadora_principles.name: AI serving humanity
hadora_principles.description: Technology placed within a wider human context; AI expands collective intelligence without replacing responsibility, judgement or meaning.

hadora_principles.name: Transformation through work
hadora_principles.description: The enterprise challenge is both a real business responsibility and a medium for human transformation.
